name: MERGED SA508 Grade 3 RPV steel electron-beam welds (forged PWHT, PM-HIP PWHT, PM-HIP SQNT): raw SE montage across each weld plus raw nanoindentation load-displacement profiles along the same traverse. Descriptor: Nemets et al. 2025 Data in Brief doi:10.1016/j.dib.2025.112158. Data: Mendeley doi:10.17632/j2f2dxmd5m.1 (forged PWHT), 10.17632/58xvm8wt92.1 (PM-HIP PWHT), 10.17632/x8x628h3gs.1 (PM-HIP SQNT). Merged from corr_sa508_ebweld_sem_nanoind + sem_nemets2025_sa508_ebw_nanoindent
state: merged 2026-10-06 by rule: (1) a field one card left null takes the other card's value unless the null card records a failed attempt on the same fact; (2) on conflict keep the lower-scoring value (false over true, smaller count, empty co-registration list over a filled one); (3) observables and laws merge as a union of distinct entries while R10 keeps the lower card count. Prospective desk facts only, nothing downloaded. Resolutions: claims null (sem) vs none/0 (corr) -> none/0 by rule 1 (sem track recorded no attempt; its notes confirm the descriptor reports no zone-level values); material-route series shared_entities false (sem) vs true (corr) -> false by rule 2 (max shared levels stay 3); sem.co_registered [] (sem) vs nanoindentation (corr) -> [] by rule 2, nanoindentation kept under same_specimen (fiducial alignment, not pixel registration); sem.image_count null (corr) -> 'over 400 tiles' (sem) by rule 1. The descriptor swaps the two PM-HIP DOIs; DataCite titles give the mapping used here. | verified desk fields 2026-10-07 from downloaded files (m0_s.py)

readers.notes: [corr] Raw and processed SE micrographs as .tif (tifffile), stitched montage with Fiji TileConfiguration.txt tile positions, one plain-text CSV of load-displacement per indent plus a condition-level Hardness Profile.csv (pandas). Over 400 micrographs in total per the descriptor. The descriptor article carries its own non-commercial article licence, which does not bind the data records [sem] SE micrographs raw and processed as .tif (tifffile), stitched mosaics with TileConfiguration.txt (Fiji stitching layout, plain text), raw load-displacement per indent as .csv and a condition-level 'Hardness Profile' .csv with per-array H and E (pandas)

calibration.notes: [corr] Raw SE images carry the instrument data bar with a scale bar (cropped in processed images); pixel size and magnification not stated in the descriptor; Helios UX, ETD, 5 kV, 0.40 nA (PM-HIP) and 0.80 nA (forged). Indenter area function and frame compliance not stated [sem] descriptor gives no pixel size or magnification; processed TIFFs have the SEM databar cropped, so read the pixel size from raw TIFF tags first. Tiles step about 140 um with about 10 um overlap (stitching offsets give a scale cross-check). Indents depth-controlled to 3000 nm at 0.2 um/s, Oliver-Pharr with Berkovich area function, FIB fiducial at the fusion-zone centre aligns the profile to the weld

observables.name: nanoindentation hardness and modulus from raw load-displacement curves (Oliver-Pharr)
observables.notes: 2 x 2 arrays (100 um spacing) every 1 mm across the weld; the deposit's Hardness Profile.csv gives the authors' hardness and modulus per array, usable for validation only | [sem] validation route: authors' per-array average H and E in the Hardness Profile .csv against our Oliver-Pharr fit of the raw curves; 2 x 2 arrays (4 indents, 100 um apart) every 1 mm | S5a (2026-10-07): synthetic pass (S5a-2), held-out FAIL vs authors (Spearman 0.891, ratio CV 0.149, ratio 0.87); V4-E28

observables.name: fusion-zone and HAZ boundary positions
observables.notes: Seen in the SE montage and as hardness steps in the indentation profile; both aligned to a FIB fiducial near the FZ centre, not point-by-point co-registered | [sem] second route: hardness steps on the same line; the authors warn that boundaries are gradual ranges, not lines

observables.name: constituent phase along the traverse (ferrite, bainite, martensite) from SE contrast
observables.notes: Descriptor gives qualitative contrast cues only, no quantitative phase fractions

observables.name: lath or packet morphology and pore fraction per tile
observables.notes: no annotations and no author values in the descriptor; SE contrast only, no EBSD or EDS

series.factor: base material route and post-weld treatment: forged PWHT, PM-HIP PWHT, PM-HIP SQNT
weld zone along the traverse: base metal, HAZ, fusion zone

laws.name: zone-boundary agreement between SE montage and hardness profile, with hardness ranking martensite > bainite > ferrite (same law as the sem card's: agreement of SEM-identified zone boundaries with nanoindentation hardness steps on the same weld-normal line)

modes: SE (Everhart-Thornley), 5 kV, 0.40 nA PM-HIP and 0.80 nA forged
sem.field_selection: systematic (stitched montage line scan normal to each weld)
same_specimen: raw nanoindentation load-displacement curves on the same weld-normal line (fiducial-aligned, not tile-registered)
